{
  "technical_and_design_decisions": [
    "Baseline stack is Java 17+, Spring Framework 6, Spring Boot, and a Maven multi-module build, consistent with the specification's stated requirements.",
    "U1: Enforce uber-jar integrity via the Maven Shade plugin configured to fail on duplicate/overlapping classes plus the extra-enforcer-rules 'banDuplicateClasses' rule, wired into CI so violations break the build.",
    "U2: The external library is extracted into a standalone Maven project/repository with its own release cycle; s-c-d consumes it as a normal versioned dependency instead of embedded sources.",
    "U3: The SFTP module is ported from Spring XD to the Spring Cloud Stream programming model (Spring Boot app with @EnableBinding(Source.class)), built on the Spring Integration SFTP inbound adapter, with externalized configuration properties replacing XD module options.",
    "U3: SFTP tests use an embedded Apache MINA SSHD server so no external SFTP infrastructure is required.",
    "U4: RedisRule and related Redis test utilities are packaged in a dedicated test-support module published as a test-scoped artifact; consuming projects reference it instead of duplicating the rule.",
    "U5: Out-of-the-box processor modules follow the Spring Cloud Stream processor contract (input and output channels) and are packaged as executable Boot uber-jars accompanied by module metadata (coordinates, options) discoverable by s-c-d.",
    "U6: AetherModuleResolver gains an 'offline' mode implemented by configuring an offline Aether repository system session that resolves artifacts only from the local Maven repository (~/.m2).",
    "U7: ModuleRegistry is implemented as a service backed by a relational store via Spring Data JPA (module coordinates entity + repository), seeded from configuration properties, and exposed through a REST controller.",
    "U8: The shell commands (module list/info/register/unregister) are thin clients over the ModuleRegistry REST endpoints, rendering tabular output and surfacing server-side validation errors."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "A single developer (the estimator) performs all work; all figures are effort in workdays, not elapsed duration.",
    "One workday equals 8 productive development hours; time for organizational meetings, vacations, and unrelated support is excluded.",
    "Abbreviations map as follows: s-c-d = Spring Cloud Data Flow, s-c-s = Spring Cloud Stream, s-c-s-m = spring-cloud-stream-modules, XD = Spring XD, OOTB = out-of-the-box.",
    "Source code for the Spring XD SFTP module and the external library is available in-house and licensed for porting/extraction; no functional redesign is required.",
    "Repositories, build infrastructure, and CI already exist; work is limited to creating new modules/projects and updating existing build configuration, not provisioning new infrastructure.",
    "ModuleRegistry persistence reuses the relational database already used by s-c-d; no new datastore is introduced.",
    "Estimates include developer-performed unit and integration testing plus reference documentation; formal QA, UAT, security audits, and performance testing are out of scope.",
    "Estimates include one normal code-review-and-rework cycle per activity; major requirement changes are excluded.",
    "RedisRule remains a JUnit 4-style rule; migration of the broader test suites to JUnit 5 extensions is excluded.",
    "Only shell and REST interfaces are delivered for module management; no graphical UI work is included.",
    "For U6, 'offline' means resolution exclusively from the local Maven repository; air-gapped repository mirroring or artifact pre-population tooling is not included."
  ],
  "activities": [
    {
      "activity_id": "ACT-01",
      "activity_name": "Uber-jar duplicate-class enforcement (U1)",
      "activity_description": "Analyze the current uber-jar for classes overridden by external libraries, clean up conflicting dependencies/exclusions, configure the Maven Shade plugin to fail on duplicates and add the banDuplicateClasses enforcer rule, and verify the build fails as expected on violations.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "ACT-02",
      "activity_name": "Extract external library into standalone project (U2)",
      "activity_description": "Create a new Maven project for the external library (poms, build, CI job, artifact publishing), migrate the code and its tests from the s-c-d repo, and update s-c-d to consume the published versioned artifact; verify a clean downstream build.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "ACT-03",
      "activity_name": "SFTP source module port - core implementation (U3)",
      "activity_description": "Port the Spring XD SFTP module to the Spring Cloud Stream model: Spring Boot application with @EnableBinding(Source.class), Spring Integration SFTP inbound adapter wiring, and typed configuration properties replacing XD module options.",
      "most_likely_effort": 4
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "ACT-04",
      "activity_name": "SFTP source module port - tests and documentation (U3)",
      "activity_description": "Implement unit and integration tests for the ported SFTP source using an embedded Apache MINA SSHD server, plus sample pipeline usage and reference documentation.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "ACT-05",
      "activity_name": "RedisRule test-support project (U4)",
      "activity_description": "Create a new isolated, reusable test-support project containing the RedisRule contract and related Redis test utilities, set up its build/publishing, and refactor existing consumers to depend on the new test-scoped artifact.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "ACT-06",
      "activity_name": "Foundation for OOTB processor modules (U5)",
      "activity_description": "Create the processor foundation: parent/starter build setup in the s-c-s-m repo, processor module contract (input/output channels), module metadata generation for discovery, build wiring, and an initial sample processor module validated end to end.",
      "most_likely_effort": 5
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "ACT-07",
      "activity_name": "Offline mode for AetherModuleResolver (U6)",
      "activity_description": "Add an offline configuration option to AetherModuleResolver that resolves module artifacts only from the local Maven repository via an offline Aether repository system session, including unit tests with local-repository fixtures and documentation of the new option.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "ACT-08",
      "activity_name": "ModuleRegistry domain model and persistence (U7)",
      "activity_description": "Define the module coordinates domain entity (name, type, Maven coordinates) and implement persistence using Spring Data JPA against the existing s-c-d relational database, including schema configuration for the supported databases.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "ACT-09",
      "activity_name": "ModuleRegistry service implementation (U7)",
      "activity_description": "Implement the default ModuleRegistry service: lookup of module coordinates by name and type, register/unregister operations with validation, initial population of well-known modules from configuration properties, and unit tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "ACT-10",
      "activity_name": "ModuleRegistry REST endpoints (U7)",
      "activity_description": "Expose the registry through a REST controller providing list (paginated), info, register, and unregister operations with input validation and error handling, covered by integration tests; these endpoints back the shell commands.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "ACT-11",
      "activity_name": "Shell module commands (U8)",
      "activity_description": "Implement the 'module list', 'module info', 'module register', and 'module unregister' commands in the s-c-d shell, including tabular rendering, argument validation, error reporting from the REST layer, and command tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "ACT-12",
      "activity_name": "Increment integration, end-to-end verification and documentation",
      "activity_description": "Integrate all delivered pieces, run end-to-end flows (module registration, offline resolution, streaming pipeline using the SFTP source and a processor), stabilize the build, and finalize reference documentation for the increment.",
      "most_likely_effort": 4
    }
  ],
  "reported_total": {
    "most_likely_effort": 40
  }
}
